description: This file defines a React-like component called NoteItem using Qwik framework, which renders a note with title, preview content, formatted update time, and edit/delete buttons. It imports external Qwik functions and types, and interacts with external callback props.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats an ISO date string into a localized string with date and time.

methods.name: contentPreview
methods.description: Creates a truncated preview of the note content.

methods.name: handleEdit$
methods.description: Wrapper function to invoke onEdit$ callback asynchronously.

methods.name: handleDelete$
methods.description: Wrapper function to invoke onDelete$ callback asynchronously.
